description: This PHP file defines a class named 'chart' responsible for generating resource allocation charts (weekly, monthly, quarterly) for projects, users, contacts, and tasks. It includes methods for rendering HTML tables, managing date calculations, and handling chart display logic within a SuiteCRM/SugarCRM context.

classes.name: chart
classes.description: A class that generates resource allocation charts for projects, users, and contacts over different time spans (weekly, monthly, quarterly). It includes methods for rendering HTML, calculating date ranges, and checking weekends.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the chart object with start/end dates, resources, and chart type, then initiates drawing the chart.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Main method responsible for generating the HTML output of the chart based on the specified type (weekly, monthly, quarterly). It handles fetching project, user, and contact data, and rendering the resource tasks over the calendar.

methods.name: year_quarter
methods.description: Returns an array of months grouped by year and quarter between start and end dates.

methods.name: year_week
methods.description: Returns an array of weeks grouped by year and month between start and end dates.

methods.name: year_month
methods.description: Returns an array of days grouped by year and month between start and end dates, with day abbreviations.

methods.name: get_weeks
methods.description: Returns an array of week numbers between start and end dates.

methods.name: count_months
methods.description: Counts months between start date and a specific day offset, returning -1 if months differ.

methods.name: count_days
methods.description: Calculates the total days between start and end dates.

methods.name: get_week_dates
methods.description: Returns the start and end date of a week given a start date and week offset.

methods.name: get_month_dates
methods.description: Returns the first and last date of a month offset from the start date.

methods.name: get_date
methods.description: Returns the date offset from the start date by a number of days.

methods.name: check_weekend
methods.description: Determines if a given date is a weekend, today, or a weekend today, based on user timezone.

methods.name: time_range
methods.description: Outputs a human-readable difference between start and end dates.

methods.name: get_cell_class
methods.description: Returns CSS class 'd' for duplicate days or 'h' for non-duplicates based on the number of days.
